title: Add delimited continuation primitive with a complete local tape bill
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR5329's local tape boundary uses a Python frame stack to recover origins, parent objects and descriptor lengths. This adds an isolated **constructive primitive and written all-size proof**: a delimited control tape restores sixteen parent payload heads, their bytes, the role mask and an opaque binary descriptor by sequential reads, writes and unit moves.

The changed encoding records each head-to-end distance in unary while parking that head. Nineteen fixed tapes and a nine-symbol alphabet suffice at every finite nesting depth. For descriptor length d, total return distance H and child payload-plus-descriptor length W, the complete matched boundary costs at most **24d + 12H + 576 + 8W** tape actions, including child cleanup. The live frame is exactly d + H + 35 symbols. Sharper exact action formulas and the nesting induction are in PROOF.md.

This completes the stated primitive, **not the full source caller**. The retained-source calibration still uses Python logical sizes and weak-reference handle allocation. Recursive C, actual child-output delivery, production dispatch/recipe semantics, complete caller space/stock/precision and supplier admission remain open. No paid-profile or kappa improvement is claimed. Only eight files in `research/segment-continuation-stack/` are added.

## Task and overlap

- Base: current canonical main `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56`, priority revision 7. The pre-submission fetch retained that head and unchanged guidance/inputs.
- Task: `uniform-transfer-audit`, **refined** to the local continuation primitive requested by the released [physical-local-continuation handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5012#discussioncomment-19151249). [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5012#discussioncomment-19152934).
- Scientific predecessor: [PR5329](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5329), `08456995d5e520a4f9e0501c9b2ea9b03dbae87a`, retained unchanged on main. PR5041 supplies the locality motivation. The central ledger marks both predecessors partially reviewed.
- The existing fixed-bank recursive-row caller has a one-bit dyadic continuation grammar; the PR3385 parent-return audit covers dense parking. This package supplies a different concrete descriptor/head contract and complete local bill, not a claim to invent stacks.
- Submission overlap: 310 open PR bodies and 4,641 Discussion records with complete reported pagination at 19:20/19:21 UTC. Sparse local-note omissions are disclosed. A supplementary Git-tree search of all top-level package READMEs checked physical/continuation-stack and unary-distance terms. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are outside coverage.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.0, 64-bit Windows 11; standard library only.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/segment-continuation-stack --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/segment-continuation-stack
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/segment-continuation-stack
```

All pass locally. Evidence:

- 1,935 complete small single-role payload/head/descriptor cases and 20 empty-mask cases; every measured boundary matches the independently written exact action formula.
- Seven nested unequal frames at ancestor lengths 16, 257 and 4096, with identical local action counts and complete state restoration.
- Six unchanged `compact.execute` calibrations on complete reduced 128-record rectangles, both field orders, two nested levels and all sixteen enclosing roles. Each inner boundary costs exactly 16,672 actions, including cleanup, at every ancestor length.
- The exact retained event8814/family65689 BOUNDARY and RIGHT-RECIPE bytes round-trip as a long opaque descriptor; this is byte preservation, not production recipe execution.
- Nine rejecting controls: malformed top/row/descriptor delimiters, excess return distance, absent nonempty role, nonbinary descriptor, omitted head return, wrong descriptor data and unpaid moves.
- Official 18-file export/integrity checks pass. Normal and optimized Git-free replay with empty PATH reproduce RESULT.json and preserve all exported bytes (6.30/6.22 s). A corrupted exported source is rejected before predecessor execution. The repository's frozen inputs were never edited.
- Scientific code/receipt at `a032168509338cbe5b5213acbdef81719e33b0a9`; final head `fd74da128f0e5ab702a8fe7b2b00e1a316bb22ad` only adds validation prose and clarifies a fixture sentence. Final committed-byte and export checks pass.

The all-size claim rests on the written proof; these finite checks corroborate it. No selected cold replay, full selected-source closure, Lean/Docker build, independent human review or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed. Full source-history preflight was unavailable in the shallow checkout. Hosted CI is separate from these local results.

Prepared by Mihir Srivastava (`mihir-s-05`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Author-checked evidence awaiting independent review.

## Open next questions

Bind one `repair/stable_radix` maximum-live cut and nested call to explicit source counter/slot operations, replacing the calibration facade. Separately, name and price one actual child-output transfer before destructive pop. Those are prerequisites for composing the complete production caller invoice; the primitive alone does not justify another construction search. README.md and TASK.json give concrete first steps and blockers.
